assumptions: Rates are approximate 2025 estimates; verify locally before procurement.
Civil rate per sqft includes structure, brickwork, plaster, roof slab; excludes land cost and approvals.

Bathroom counts and fixture types affect sanitary estimate; plumbing routes influence line costs.
Estimate excludes GST, architect fees, interior designer fees, and site-specific foundations where applicable.

Boundary wall, gate, and external development beyond plinth
Lift, STP, and specialized systems if any

cost.note: Approximate planning estimate only — not a binding quotation. Confirm with a licensed contractor and updated local Schedule of Rates.

parsed_input.original_text:
Design a modern single-floor 3BHK residential house
with a built-up area of approximately 1500 square feet.

Include three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two balconies,
a spacious living room, an open modular kitchen,
and a dining area.

Prioritize efficient room placement, natural lighting,
cross-ventilation, practical circulation space,
and a northeast-facing main entrance.

Generate a detailed 2D floorplan, an interactive
3D digital twin, architectural validation results,
and an estimated construction cost breakdown.

orientation.note: Top of 2D plan is NORTH (0°). Entrance on top_right wall per north_east facing.
